name: smwgraphics-earthworm-jim-snes-snot-a-problem
title: Earthworm Jim (SNES) - Snot a Problem
description:
The layer 3 version can work with the layer 2 version. There are 3 color choices.

You'll need a patch to free the upper half layer 3 that the vanilla status bar uses. In other words, status bars like Minimalist, SMB3 status bar or even some sprite-based status bar like the DKCR Styled status bar.
